title: PHC Holdings surge to near 4-year high after Toho takeover proposal confirmed
title_zh: PHC Holdings surge to near 4-year high after Toho takeover proposal confirmed
summary: Investing.com -- PHC Holdings (TYO:6523) shares surged to a near four-year high, after the Japanese healthcare company confirmed it had received an initial takeover proposal from Toho Holdings.

title: Constellation Energy stock climbs on Amazon nuclear power deal
title_zh: Constellation Energy stock climbs on Amazon nuclear power deal
summary: Investing.com -- Constellation Energy Corp (NASDAQ:CEG) shares rose as much as 5% in after-hours trading Wednesday following the announcement of a 20-year nuclear power agreement with Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN).

title: What Could Morgan Stanley (MS) Merger Talks Mean For Investors?
title_zh: What Could Morgan Stanley (MS) Merger Talks Mean For Investors?
summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) is reportedly exploring a potential merger or combination with UBS AG under pressure from Swiss regulators. Swiss authorities are said to be urging UBS to reinforce its capital position, prompting discussions with several large foreign banks.

title: Amazon Signs $1 Billion Synopsys Deal as AWS Steps Up Nvidia Challenge
title_zh: Amazon Signs $1 Billion Synopsys Deal as AWS Steps Up Nvidia Challenge
summary: Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) announced a multi-year deal worth more than $1 billion with Synopsys Inc. (NASDAQ:SNPS) Wednesday, expanding the chip-design technology behind AWS's custom silicon push as it builds alternatives to processors from Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA).

title: Salesforce up 3.2% after announcing Listen Labs acquisition
title_zh: Salesforce up 3.2% after announcing Listen Labs acquisition
summary: Shares of Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM, XETRA:FOO) were up 3.2% on Wednesday after the company signed a definitive agreement to acquire Listen Labs, an AI-powered customer research and human simulation platform.
